title: Giraffe wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- neck -->
  <rect x='40' y='42' width='18' height='32' rx='6' fill='#F2B93B'/>
  <!-- neck spots -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='50' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#C67A1E'/>
  <ellipse cx='53' cy='62' rx='3.5' ry='4.5' fill='#C67A1E'/>
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='68' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#C67A1E'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='80' rx='26' ry='15' fill='#F2B93B'/>
  <!-- body spots -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='80' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#C67A1E'/>
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='74' rx='4.5' ry='4' fill='#C67A1E'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='84' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#C67A1E'/>
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='88' rx='4' ry='3.5' fill='#C67A1E'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='34' y='89' width='7' height='9' rx='3' fill='#E0A52F'/>
  <rect x='46' y='91' width='7' height='8' rx='3' fill='#C67A1E'/>
  <rect x='58' y='90' width='7' height='9' rx='3' fill='#E0A52F'/>
  <rect x='70' y='88' width='7' height='10' rx='3' fill='#C67A1E'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='47' cy='36' rx='16' ry='13' fill='#F2B93B'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='41' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#F7D27A'/>
  <!-- nostrils -->
  <circle cx='61' cy='41' r='1.2' fill='#C67A1E'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='43' r='1.2' fill='#C67A1E'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='49' cy='33' r='3.2' fill='#5A3A0A'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='32' r='1.1' fill='#FFF3D1'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='27' rx='4' ry='6' fill='#F2B93B' transform='rotate(-25 36 27)'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='25' rx='4' ry='6' fill='#F2B93B' transform='rotate(20 58 25)'/>
  <!-- ossicones (horns) -->
  <rect x='40' y='20' width='3.5' height='9' rx='1.7' fill='#E0A52F'/>
  <circle cx='41.7' cy='19' r='3' fill='#C67A1E'/>
  <rect x='50' y='19' width='3.5' height='10' rx='1.7' fill='#E0A52F'/>
  <circle cx='51.7' cy='18' r='3' fill='#C67A1E'/>
  <!-- party hat -->
  <polygon points='44,10 56,10 50,23' fill='#3FD0E8'/>
  <!-- hat stripes -->
  <polygon points='44.8,13 55.2,13 54.4,16 45.6,16' fill='#FF5FA2'/>
  <polygon points='46,18 54,18 53.2,21 46.8,21' fill='#FFE14D'/>
  <!-- hat pom-pom -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='9' r='3.5' fill='#FF5FA2'/>
  <!-- hat brim highlight -->
  <rect x='43' y='21.5' width='14' height='2' rx='1' fill='#6EE7F5'/>
</svg>
